site_name: Microsoft SAT80 campus (SAT80-1, SAT80-2), 3580 FM 471 N, Castroville TX 78253
verification: Lead, not a verification: the Blackridge profile (updated 2026-05-05) says in past tense that SAT80 and SAT81 came online in Q3 2024 and labels them operational. I am not accepting it because (1) the same page ties this row's address, 3580 FM 471 N, to SAT82's second filing with groundbreaking set for August 2026 and completion by July 2028; (2) the Q3 2024 date is unsourced and the page is internally inconsistent (says construction began late 2023, while San Antonio Report on 2023-08-07 already had SAT80-1/SAT80-2 under construction; July vs August 2023 announcement; two different locations for SAT80/81); the date may be a TDLR schedule restated as fact (inference). San Antonio Report 2024-08-25 describes SAT82 as to be built next to SAT80-1 and SAT80-2 but does not say they were operating; its 2025-03-01 article gives no status. Microsoft's community page says only that it operates datacenters in Bexar and Medina counties. If the row is confirmed to be the SAT80/81 campus (the project's permit year of 2023 suggests it is), Blackridge would support 2024 at medium confidence; a Medina County appraisal record or TDLR closed-project record would settle it. The researcher notes a directory gives 2025.

lead.notes: Black Ridge Research reports SAT80 and SAT81 buildings came online Q3 2024. However, Baxtel lists year built as 2025, creating a conflict. The facilities are described as operational. TDLR records show construction permit registered July 2023. Medium confidence due to source conflict on exact timing.

verification: Accepted under the rule for a state project registration marked closed with a completion date. Material caveat, consistent with the first check: the field label is 'Completion Date' (not 'Estimated'), but the exact one-year, first-of-month dates (4/1/2021 to 4/1/2022) look like values entered at registration, and the page lists no inspection date; that reading is inference, not stated on the page. The page says nothing about opening or commissioning, so actual delivery could be later than 2022. QTS's San Antonio page shows 90 MW+ with no 'In Development' label but gives no year. Field values were read through WebFetch's summarizer; the quote is a field-by-field transcription with ellipses between fields. Researcher's 'high' confidence is not warranted; medium at most.

verification: Texas TDLR architectural-barriers project record for the matching address. Fields as returned: Start Date 12/1/2011, Completion Date 6/1/2012, Current Status 'Project Closed', Type of Work 'Renovation/Alteration', Tenant 'Not Assigned'. This meets the medium rule for a state project registration marked closed with a construction-completion date. Caveats: (1) the page says nothing about opening or operations; 2012 is a construction-completion year, and the first-of-month dates look like registered estimates (inference); (2) the work is a fit-out of an existing 150,000 sf building, so the record does not rule out earlier data center use of that building. The researcher's account that it was previously an unoccupied Stream powered shell was not checked on any page I opened. The first checker's 'not_supported' reflected a stricter reading; under this task's rubric the closed record qualifies at medium.

site_name: Vantage Data Centers TX11, 14720 Omicron Drive, San Antonio TX 78245
verification: The TDLR page shows Start Date 11/11/2024, Completion Date 8/12/2025, Current Status "Review Complete," Type of Work New Construction, no inspection date. "Review Complete" is the plan-review status, not a closed or inspected project, and the page does not say whether the completion date is actual or planned, so under the rules this is a target completion date on a project not marked finished. The scope is a tenant build-out, which may be a fit-out rather than first delivery of the building. Vantage's own site lists San Antonio as a location with no status, and its news and blog search return nothing on San Antonio or TX11. 2025 is plausible but unsupported by any page saying the building is open or delivered.
